name: Mazagan Beach & Golf Resort
positioning: Large Atlantic beach resort in Morocco on 250 hectares with 7 kilometers of beachside, mixing Moroccan tradition with contemporary design
best_for: Families wanting family rooms or spacious ocean-view suites
Travelers who want a big beach resort with many places to eat and drink

facts.text: The resort is about an hour from Casablanca Airport in Morocco.
Rooms and suites combine Moroccan tradition with contemporary design.
Guests can choose from six distinct room types.
Ground-floor Patio Family Rooms are available.
The suites offer ample space and ocean views, and are suited to large families.
The concierge can arrange restaurant or spa bookings, activities, and trips to Moroccan cities from Casablanca to Marrakech.
The resort has 15 bars and restaurants.
Al Firma serves traditional Moroccan cuisine in a Berber tent, using organic, seasonal ingredients grown in the Al Firma garden.

highlights.text: The resort sprawls across 250 hectares with 7 kilometers of beachside.
Rooms and suites overlook the Grand Riad pool, gardens and forest, or the Atlantic Ocean.
Family rooms have views of the gardens, the golf course and the forest.
The decor of the Studio 42 lounge bar is inspired by the studios where scenes of the film Casablanca were filmed.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the resort is outside the main El Jadida city center.
WhataHotel notes that a resort this large may feel less intimate; it spreads across 250 hectares.
Le Show by Buddha-Bar, with fire dancers, is staged at Bushra by Buddha-Bar on July and August nights.
